verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a native search feature spanning tasks, docs, and comments, nor any claims about search speed or accuracy; the closest analog is an MCP query like 'find my incomplete tasks due this week,' which is a natural-language AI query tool, not evidence of a fast, accurate cross-content search capability. Community comments even flag general app performance issues (e.g., 'worst performing web app'), but nothing specifically addresses search functionality.
